description: Plan articles that link to one of the person's product or service pages: the action item's "Plan 3 articles that link here". Up to 3 articles about the page's main search, in the formats the workspace has on, each asked to link to the page once; they go on the calendar as planned articles. Defaults to a DRY RUN. When the person asked for this, call it with confirm=true. Item ids come from get_insights.

confirm.description: Set true to put the articles on the calendar (default: dry run)

name: plan_insight_articles
